fusions.name: Long Run-Up
fusions.desc: A hoof-driven blow within 8 tiles that deals 10 damage, up to 2 times as much at its farthest reach. It knocks the target 3 tiles back and leaves it [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thunder Underfoot
fusions.desc: Pounds a 4-tile track of hoofbeats ahead of you for 4 seconds. It deals 4 damage to each enemy that crosses it and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Barded Plod
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Built-Up Stride
fusions.desc: When you have walked a long way, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
